Map DigitizerTeam Wavelets — accessible routing

Layers

One layer per floor. The campus map is built in, so it's always the same picture. You can also drag a floor plan onto the workspace or paste one with Ctrl+V.

Import from this SVG

Names are guessed from the nearest building label on the map — check them in the node table. Running this again skips anything already placed.

Scale

Click two points a known distance apart — a scale bar, a doorway (~0.9 m), a corridor you paced out.

Tool

Ctrl + scroll to zoom. Hold Space and drag (or drag with the middle mouse button) to pan.
